parts.title: Giving clear directions
questions: When did you last ask someone for directions?
What kind of landmark is easiest to remember?
Do you prefer directions on a map or in words?
What makes a sign difficult to follow?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a time when you gave someone directions or explained how to find something.
questions: Say what the person was looking for.
Explain how you gave the directions.
Describe how you checked that they understood.
Explain what made the explanation easy or difficult.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: Should public directions be designed mainly for first-time visitors?
How can a sign communicate when several languages are spoken?
Why can information that is correct still lead people to the wrong place?
What is an effective way to test whether new signs work?
